summary: Backend-only test of selection auto-backfill fix (iter85). 9/9 tests pass — all 8 requested scenarios verified plus scheduler smoke test. The resilience fix for Routal webhook outages works correctly: skips API when pending>0, returns routal_inactive when integration disabled, stages plans when API returns data, and the manual endpoint contract is preserved (no auto-backfill in POST /api/selection/run/{client_id}). Regressions iter83 (/api/admin/routes-report) and iter84 (/api/health checks.routal_sync) still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: services/selection_backfill.py uses `consecutive_below` heuristic (>=2 pages with 90% below range → stop) — adequate, but when Routal returns plans in non-strict date order (e.g. paused/rescheduled plans), some in-range plans may be missed. Low probability but worth a note.

backfill_plans_for_date always calls rc.aclose() in finally — good. But the outer exception handler wraps only _request; get_plan errors are individually caught per-plan which is correct and resilient.

maybe_backfill_if_empty uses `processed: False` as the 'pending' signal. Correct for fresh-day scenario; re-runs within same cutoff won't re-backfill because run_daily_selection marks plans processed=True. This is the desired behavior.
Scheduler loop catches backfill errors separately from run_daily_selection (good isolation) — if backfill fails but Routal webhook later arrives, next cutoff will still work normally.

Consider: if backfill results in staged=0 AND error='routal_inactive' (integration disabled for a client that has selection_enabled=True), the scheduler still calls run_daily_selection which returns total=0. That's fine, but operations should be alerted. Currently only logged at INFO level.
seed_data_creation: All test data uses TEST_iter85_<uuid> client_id prefix and is cleaned up in try/finally. No persistent seed left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter85_selection_backfill.py covers the selection_backfill resilience layer (iter85 fix). The db fixture creates a fresh Motor client per-test to avoid event-loop-reuse issues with module-scope Motor clients under pytest-asyncio (strict mode). Uses unittest.mock.patch on IntegrationService.get_routal_client and on workers.routal_event_processor._handle_plan_created_direct. Regression markers: iter83 endpoint /api/admin/routes-report REQUIRES date_from & date_to query params. Scheduler loop logs 'started' and 'cancelled' lines cleanly under hot-reload — no backfill import errors.
rca of the issue: Original bug RCA (from problem statement): Cubbo MX stopped receiving Routal webhooks since 2026-04-26 → routal_daily_plans empty → scheduler tick finds 0 staged plans → 0 drivers selected. Fix validated: services/selection_backfill.py adds a fallback that pulls plans directly from Routal API /v2/plans when staging is empty, then hydrates via /v2/plan/{id}. Scheduler now calls maybe_backfill_if_empty() BEFORE run_daily_selection, making the system resilient to webhook outages. Manual endpoint POST /api/selection/run/{client_id} was explicitly left unchanged (contract preserved).
